video_title: iPhone 18 Pro Review: All About that Chip
user_question: Should I buy the iPhone 18 Pro or wait for the next model?
question_interpretation: The asker wants advice on whether to purchase the iPhone 18 Pro now or wait for a future iPhone model.

categories.name: RECOMMEND_BUY_NOW
categories.description: Positive endorsement to purchase the iPhone 18 Pro now.
include_when: comment praises the iPhone 18 Pro's features and says it’s worth buying
explicitly tells the asker to buy it now
states the phone offers good value for price
exclude_when: mentions waiting for a future model
examples: The new camera and chip are game‑changing, definitely worth the upgrade now.
Buy the 18 Pro today; the performance boost is noticeable and the price is justified.

categories.name: RECOMMEND_WAIT_FOR_NEXT
categories.description: Advice to hold off and wait for the next iPhone model.
examples: Apple barely improved anything, wait for the next generation.
Hold off until the next iPhone; the 18 Pro isn’t a real upgrade.

categories.name: RECOMMEND_ALTERNATIVE
categories.description: Suggests buying a different phone instead of the iPhone 18 Pro.
include_when: compares and says alternative is better value
points out features missing in iPhone 18 Pro
examples: If you want a better camera, go for the Samsung S26 Ultra instead.
Consider the Pixel 8 Pro; it offers more features for less money.

categories.name: INDECISION
categories.description: Expresses genuine uncertainty without a clear recommendation.
include_when: shows equal pros and cons without leaning
examples: I’m torn between the 18 Pro and waiting for the next model.
Can’t decide if the upgrade is worth it; need more info.

categories.name: NEUTRAL_INFO
categories.description: Provides relevant factual information without taking a stance.
include_when: shares specs, rumors, or video details
mentions price or release date only
exclude_when: includes any recommendation or personal preference
examples: The iPhone 18 Pro uses a 2‑nanometer chip and a variable aperture lens.
It launches on September 14 at $1199 for the base model.
